BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

3. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

7. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   B. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   B. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.

13. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   D. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
